description: Source code defining a utility class 'GPULimits' that provides theoretical limits and performance metrics for Nvidia GPU devices, including FLOPs, memory bandwidth, and tensor core capabilities.

classes.name: GPULimits
classes.description: Utility class for Nvidia GPU device limits and performance metrics.

methods.name: get_fma_per_cycle_per_sm_cuda_cores
methods.description: Returns FMA instructions per cycle per SM for a given data type without tensor cores.

methods.name: get_fma_per_cycle_per_sm_tensor_cores
methods.description: Returns FMA instructions per cycle per SM for a given data type with tensor cores.

methods.name: get_tflops_per_second
methods.description: Calculates the theoretical TFLOPS per second for the GPU, optionally using tensor cores.

methods.name: get_memory_bandwidth_Bps
methods.description: Calculates the memory bandwidth in bytes per second.

methods.name: get_shared_memory_bandwidth_Bps
methods.description: Calculates the shared memory bandwidth in bytes per second.
